objective: Test one exact live-compatible one-bucket board evaluator warm-started from the shipped model and trained on every independently depth-12-scored legal child, without reopening the rejected V9, HalfKP, or hashed-policy recipes.
claim_boundary: A complete static pass authorizes only the fail-closed screen56 match. It is not playing-strength, high-dan, production, or live-promotion evidence.

difference_from_prior_lanes.v9: V9 used the one-bucket board representation but trained from depth-16 MultiPV/top-candidate labels rather than a complete legal-move set.
difference_from_prior_lanes.halfkp: The HalfKP browser-confusion lane used the complete depth-12 legal-move set but an 81-bucket approximately 94.7 MiB representation that cannot be shipped as the current browser asset.
difference_from_prior_lanes.this_pilot: This is the untested cross: the exact shipped one-bucket 2282-256-32-1 evaluator, exact live warm start, complete all-legal sibling labels, value replay, and an exact 1185988-byte export.
difference_from_prior_lanes.data_freshness: The 643-parent validation set has already had aggregate metrics exposed. It is prospective reject-only evidence, not a fresh or sealed strength holdout.

live_weights.role: read-only exact int16 baseline and export-layout authority

legal_sibling_validation.role: reject-only final static evaluation; forbidden for epoch or hyperparameter selection

exact_live_int16_on_643_parents.metric_implementation: ml/train_board_all_legal_warmstart.py ranking_metrics; exact production cp_int=trunc(out_q*600/8128) toward zero; pessimistic ties

historical_66_of_643_reference.reason_for_separate_registration: The previously reported 66/643 is not the live one-bucket int16 score. It is the alpha-0.5 HalfKP initializer result and is retained only as a stronger absolute top-1 hurdle.

exact_live_int16_value_on_2959_rows.value_loss_kind: mean squared error between sigmoid(cp_int/600) and sigmoid(clamped_teacher_cp/600), where cp_int=trunc(out_q*600/8128) toward zero

model.candidate_export_layout: exact production seven-tensor little-endian int16/int32 layout

training.replay_sample: uniform without replacement after sibling and value-holdout semantic exclusion
training.retune_policy: No extra seed, arm, epoch, learning-rate, loss weight, temperature, data, architecture, or threshold after dispatch or rejection.

metric_definitions.top1: A parent is correct only when every move tied at candidate maximum is teacher-best.
metric_definitions.recall_at_k: Use pessimistic rank: all non-teacher-best moves tied with the best-scoring teacher-best move count ahead of it.
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_5: Teacher relevance is exp(clamp(teacher_cp-best_cp,-1200,0)/100); candidate ties use deterministic teacher-worst-first ordering.
metric_definitions.pair50_and_pair200: Micro-average unequal teacher pairs at or above the CP gap; predicted ties are incorrect because teacher_delta*predicted_delta must be strictly positive.
metric_definitions.production_cp: For every quantized ranking, value, and export-parity claim use cp_int=trunc(out_q*600/8128) toward zero; value logits are cp_int/600.
metric_definitions.static_comparator: candidate exact exported production cp_int against exact live production cp_int on identical rows and parents

static_gate.parity_position_selection: first 200 validation child rows in the exact authenticated file order
static_gate.candidate_source: fixed final epoch 3 only; no validation-selected checkpoint
static_gate.on_failure: Permanently reject this exact single-arm recipe before screen56; do not reinterpret metrics or add a retry.

pre_screen_runtime_safety.reason: A direct evaluator changes tree values and therefore the visited node set; node reduction is not an apples-to-apples strength proxy.

screen56.precondition: Every static, value, quantization, export, parity, coverage, semantic, and runtime-safety check passed.
screen56.early_stop: Only mathematical futility is allowed: stop when candidate_halfpoints + 2*remaining_games < 62.
screen56.on_failure: STOP this candidate and this exact recipe; no threshold or opening substitution.
screen56.on_pass: Authorize only a separately registered independent96 continuation, never a live write.

stop_rules: STOP before optimizer creation on any input byte, SHA-256, row, parent, game, schema, source, rank, sign, legal-set, or semantic-isolation mismatch.
Train exactly one arm and one seed, freeze epoch 3 before reading validation labels, and evaluate the reject set once.
Do not select among epochs 1, 2, and 3; only the fixed final epoch is a candidate.
Require every static gate conjunct; missing, non-finite, incomplete, or malformed evidence is failure.
Do not start screen56 unless static admission and the read-only runtime-safety check both pass.
Never write or replace public/shogi-nnue-weights.bin from this plan.
